Performance & Risks: Strengthens supplier relationships during demand uncertainty; reduces supplier bankruptcy risk; improves Ford's cash position; supplier participation voluntary (incentive-based)
Transformation Era Context (2018-2024): Introduced/expanded as part of Ford+ operational efficiency improvements; critical during 2020 pandemic and 2023 UAW strike to maintain supplier relationships

Strategic Approach: Multiple suppliers for most components to reduce single-source dependency; geographic diversification (avoid geographic concentration)
Key Details: Two or more suppliers for critical components (except where single supplier is strategic like batteries); geographic spread reduces tariff/political risk; supplier relationship management intensive
Performance & Risks: Reduces catastrophic risk from single supplier failure; increases procurement complexity and cost (less scale per supplier); supplier financial health directly impacts Ford
Transformation Era Context (2018-2024): Implemented/reinforced after 2021-2022 supply chain disruptions; critical for managing geopolitical risks (China, Mexico, Turkey, Vietnam)

Strategic Approach: Safety stock for critical materials (batteries, chips); supplier inventory buffers; seasonal adjustments for demand volatility; lean inventory for cost management

Performance & Risks: Balances inventory carrying cost vs supply disruption risk; working capital optimization critical to EBIT; inventory reduces downside risk from supply shocks
Transformation Era Context (2018-2024): Ford+ includes supply chain resilience as operational priority; working capital management improved through digital systems and predictive analytics

Strategic Approach: Manufacturing in multiple regions (North America, Europe, China, Mexico, Vietnam, Turkey); sourcing from multiple regions; tariff hedging through USMCA optimization

Transformation Era Context (2018-2024): Maintained and expanded through Ford+ transformation; Mexico nearshoring increased; China joint ventures continued despite tensions; Turkey operations managing inflation/FX volatility
